findings.title: Poor Largest Contentful Paint (LCP > 4.0s)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The largest visible element (hero image, banner, or heading) took longer than 4.0 seconds to render, signaling significant perceptual slowness.

fixSteps.instruction: Preload critical hero images and optimize image formats using modern AVIF/WebP.
Ensure your server response time (TTFB) is fast and avoid render-blocking CSS/JavaScript.

findings.title: Insufficient Color Contrast (WCAG 1.4.3 AA)
findings.plainEnglishCause: Text elements do not meet the minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their background color, making text hard or impossible to read for users with visual impairments.

fixSteps.instruction: Adjust the foreground text color or background color to satisfy WCAG AA contrast guidelines.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.plainEnglishCause: No Content-Security-Policy header was detected. Without a CSP, the application is more susceptible to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and malicious script injection.

fixSteps.instruction: Configure a restrictive Content Security Policy specifying allowed script, style, and connect origins.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header (Clickjacking Risk)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The page does not set X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, allowing third-party sites to embed your pages in an iframe and attempt clickjacking attacks.

fixSteps.instruction: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.plainEnglishCause: Browsers may attempt MIME-type sniffing on responses that lack the 'nosniff' header, which can lead to unexpected script execution from non-executable file uploads.

fixSteps.instruction: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses.

findings.title: Missing robots.txt File
findings.plainEnglishCause: No robots.txt file was found at the root of the domain. While search engines can still crawl, having a robots.txt allows you to direct crawler traffic and specify sitemap locations.

fixSteps.instruction: Create a public/robots.txt file at the root of your web server.

findings.title: Missing sitemap.xml File
findings.plainEnglishCause: No sitemap.xml file was discovered at /sitemap.xml. Sitemaps help search engine crawlers index all your public URLs efficiently.

fixSteps.instruction: Generate and host a sitemap.xml file at the root of your domain.

findings.title: Health Check Endpoint Unreachable or Failing
findings.plainEnglishCause: Probing common health check routes (/health, /api/health) returned an error or 404 status. Automated monitors and orchestrators (Kubernetes, AWS ALB) rely on this endpoint to verify container health.
findings.technicalDetails: Neither /health nor /api/health returned an active 2xx status code.

fixSteps.instruction: Expose a lightweight /health or /api/health route that returns status 200 and basic runtime status.

findings.title: Uncaught JavaScript Console Error
findings.plainEnglishCause: A JavaScript runtime exception or unhandled promise rejection occurred in the browser console during page execution. This can break user interaction or crash React component trees.
findings.technicalDetails: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 ()

fixSteps.instruction: Review the stack trace and component error boundaries to catch errors gracefully.

findings.title: Failed Network Request (4xx / 5xx)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The browser attempted to load a resource or hit an API endpoint that returned an HTTP error code, resulting in failed data rendering or broken UI.

fixSteps.instruction: Check if the requested API route or asset URL is deployed and accessible. Ensure authentication tokens and request URLs are correct.

findings.title: Missing Meta Description Tag
findings.plainEnglishCause: The HTML document lacks a <meta name="description"> tag. Search engines may display arbitrary page text in search result snippets.
findings.technicalDetails: Missing <meta name="description"> tag in document head.

fixSteps.instruction: Add a concise, informative meta description (50-160 characters) inside the <head> tag.
fixSteps.codeSnippet:
<head>
  <meta name="description" content="SiteDoctor — Real-Time Full-Stack Health & Fix Diagnostics Platform." />
</head>

findings.title: Missing Mobile Viewport Meta Tag
findings.plainEnglishCause: The document lacks a viewport meta tag. Mobile browsers will render the page at desktop width, breaking responsive mobile usability.

fixSteps.instruction: Add the standard mobile viewport tag to the document <head>.

findings.plainEnglishCause: No Content-Security-Policy header was detected. Without a CSP, the application is more susceptible to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and malicious script injection.

fixSteps.instruction: Configure a restrictive Content Security Policy specifying allowed script, style, and connect origins.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header (Clickjacking Risk)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The page does not set X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, allowing third-party sites to embed your pages in an iframe and attempt clickjacking attacks.

fixSteps.instruction: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.plainEnglishCause: Browsers may attempt MIME-type sniffing on responses that lack the 'nosniff' header, which can lead to unexpected script execution from non-executable file uploads.

fixSteps.instruction: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses.

findings.title: Missing robots.txt File
findings.plainEnglishCause: No robots.txt file was found at the root of the domain. While search engines can still crawl, having a robots.txt allows you to direct crawler traffic and specify sitemap locations.

fixSteps.instruction: Create a public/robots.txt file at the root of your web server.

findings.title: Missing sitemap.xml File
findings.plainEnglishCause: No sitemap.xml file was discovered at /sitemap.xml. Sitemaps help search engine crawlers index all your public URLs efficiently.

fixSteps.instruction: Generate and host a sitemap.xml file at the root of your domain.

findings.title: Health Check Endpoint Unreachable or Failing
findings.plainEnglishCause: Probing common health check routes (/health, /api/health) returned an error or 404 status. Automated monitors and orchestrators (Kubernetes, AWS ALB) rely on this endpoint to verify container health.
findings.technicalDetails: Neither /health nor /api/health returned an active 2xx status code.

fixSteps.instruction: Expose a lightweight /health or /api/health route that returns status 200 and basic runtime status.

findings.title: Missing Meta Description Tag
findings.plainEnglishCause: The HTML document lacks a <meta name="description"> tag. Search engines may display arbitrary page text in search result snippets.
findings.technicalDetails: Missing <meta name="description"> tag in document head.

fixSteps.instruction: Add a concise, informative meta description (50-160 characters) inside the <head> tag.
